en.title: Relief from the asset risk charge for assets excluded from Eligible Capital "in accordance with the table B1": the phrase can be read two ways (PINS and TRR)
en.summary: PINS Schedule 5, paragraph 4.4: an insurer "need not include an amount in the asset risk charge for any asset excluded from Eligible Capital in accordance with the table B1 in paragraph 4.1". Table B1 sets charges and excludes nothing from Eligible Capital; the exclusions are in Schedule 3, paragraph 5. If the words "in accordance with the table B1" go with "the asset risk charge", the relief covers assets excluded under Schedule 3, which is the evident purpose. If they go with "excluded", the relief covers no asset. TRR Schedule 5, paragraph 4.4 is the same.
en.correction: Please make the reference clear, for example "... for any asset excluded from Eligible Capital under paragraph 5 of Schedule 3", in both rulebooks.
